ModMetaData.name: [CF] Arellian Beta 1.7
ModMetaData.author: ChemFuel
ModMetaData.description:
Mod Version: 0.04b Unofficial (? ?, ?) Stage: Open Beta (⚠ Very unstable. Expect bugs, missing content, and balance changes.)
The Arellians are a genetically-engineered feline xenotype originating from the glitterworld empire known as the Kaiserinreich. Highly disciplined, technologically advanced, and deeply militarized, they bring industrial and spacer-grade equipment, military ranks, and their own imperial faction to the Rim.
Whether you earn noble titles through loyal service or simply loot their equipment from the battlefield, the Kaiserinreich is a formidable presence.
This mod is currently in active development. Feedback, bug reports, and balance suggestions are greatly appreciated.
